title: curl_memrchr: keep reverse searches within the buffer
body:
When no match is found, the previous fallback in `Curl_memrchr()` decremented `p` before the start of the buffer (`s - 1`), which is undefined pointer arithmetic under C 6.5.6p8.

Use a decreasing index `p[--n]` guarded by `while(n)` instead. This avoids forming an out-of-bounds pointer and simplifies the loop while keeping behavior identical.
